answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with licensed river voyages: each identity must crew one real cargo voyage down a named river, its manifest verified by an independent river authority, while random signal checks demand the holder answer live from the vessel within minutes. One operator cannot crew two voyages at once, and the voyage fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real river voyage, another crew, another live response, and twice the prior fee.
